summaryZh: Shpyrko Research Group 研究硬与软凝聚态系统的纳米尺度结构动力学。实验室开发相干 X 射线散射方法，覆盖电子磁性相、流体、胶体、聚合物、玻璃及纳米限域材料。

evidence.quote: We are an experimental condensed matter physics group in the Department of Physics at the University of California, San Diego .
Our group studies nanoscale structural dynamics
developing novel coherent x-ray scattering techniques to probe dynamics
soft matter including fluids, colloids, nanoparticles, polymers and glasses as well as behavior of materials in nanoscale confinement.
